comparison.objective: Advance an M10 tap a quarter turn with a two-handled wrench, then back off to break the chip.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual balanced wrench torque with axial alignment versus single fine-bit engagement, collar regrasping, locking, and feedback-driven tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Specified forward and reverse tap rotations without lateral loading or breakage versus two dynamically compliant carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Both include bounded rotary manipulation, but tapping tests coordinated bimanual cutting and side-load avoidance, not adjustment commissioning. No spec versions add further thresholds.
